mentions.note: club President; formerly Polytechnic Harriers; joined Belgrave October 1927 aged 33; 4th in Club 10 miles c.c. championship and won its handicap 1928; 37th Southern C.C. championship; first Belgrave man home (63rd scoring) in the National at Leamington

share.d: W. G. (Bill) Webb in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1950: 1 mention in 1 issue and 1 race result.
